a: Up to 30,000 NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU-hours, or up to eight RTX PRO 6000 GPUs (Simulation and Modeling call)
dt: Apply through the program portal; no deadline is posted on the program page, and timing is set in each call for proposals
e: Competitive awards of GPU time or hardware for academic projects in simulation and modeling (scientific simulation, physics-informed machine learning), AI training and model development, and AI inference and systems software. Applicants must be full-time faculty at a PhD-granting institution, worldwide, and projects must use NVIDIA pretrained models or software distributions.
n: NVIDIA Academic Grant Program (GPU hours and hardware)
unv: Submission windows are not stated on the program page; third-party listings describe quarterly review windows.
